006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
012
013import java.util.List;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * Represents a set of constraints that target a given definition using a target
019 * Metapath expression.
020 */
021public interface ITargetedConstraints extends IValueConstrained {
022  /**
023   * Get the Metapath expressions used to identify the targets of the constraint.
024   *
025   * @return the Metapath expressions identifying the targets of the associated
026   *         constraints
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  List<IMetapathExpression> getTargets();
030
031  /**
032   * Apply the constraint to the provided definition.
033   *
034   * @param definition
035   *          the definition to apply the constraint to
036   */
037  void target(@NonNull IFlagDefinition definition);
038
039  /**
040   * Apply the constraint to the provided definition.
041   *
042   * @param definition
043   *          the definition to apply the constraint to
044   */
045  void target(@NonNull IFieldDefinition definition);
046
047  /**
048   * Apply the constraint to the provided definition.
049   *
050   * @param definition
051   *          the definition to apply the constraint to
052   */
053  void target(@NonNull IAssemblyDefinition definition);
054}
